correctness.rationale: Exact proof: for M absolute coordinates above threshold, crossed nonantipodal edges M(5-M) give polygon types; conditional great-circle differentiation gives a2 and a3 with derivatives -2+4theta/pi and -3+12theta/pi; explicit J is their exact antiderivative; inclusion–exclusion yields all three probability branches. The derivative of quadrilateral probability is positive below 1/sqrt3, strictly decreases from +3 to -3 on the middle interval, and equals -3 thereafter; unique t star follows exactly. Delivered checker enumerates 12 edges for 250000 Haar normals at eight offsets, with discrepancies <0.0012, as supporting diagnostics only. No unproved infinite inference from sampling.

originality.rationale: The accepted new result is the complete probability law for section polygon types at every offset and unique optimal quadrilateral offset. Prior regular-octahedron width distribution already implies the probability of no section and evaluates a pair-cap overlap for a middle interval; those ingredients are explicitly credited, not claimed as new. The full threshold count and three-cap probability at small offset, its distinct four/six-vertex distributions, and strict global optimization are absent from the inspected prior source statements. Liu–Tkocz optimize noncentral section volumes, not their Haar type probabilities; Brandenburg–De Loera–Meroni classify potential types without this fixed-distance law. An undiscovered equivalent formula remains possible.
